name: Kawarazaki-ke no Ichizoku 2
source: Kawarazaki Manor was a mansion located deep in the mountains, as splendid as it was foreboding. Yuuma was dragged there by his girlfriend Anna to celebrate the birthday of the master Nawatsuma and visit with her cousins Maki and Tomoki. Experience Yuuma's nightmare as he lives and re-lives the next two days over and over in the distorted reality of Kawarazaki Manor. Can Yuuma and Anna escape with their sanity? Or will they succumb to the Manor's madness?
translation: 河原崎庄园是一座深藏山中的宅邸，既富丽堂皇，又令人不寒而栗。悠马被女友安娜拉到这里，参加庄园主人绳纲的生日庆典，并拜访她的表亲真希与智树。悠马将在河原崎庄园扭曲的现实中，一遍又一遍地重复经历接下来的两天，亲身承受这场噩梦。悠马与安娜能否保持理智并成功逃脱？还是会屈服于庄园的疯狂？
